clips.title: The story
paras: At Sentinel Hill, Scout Riell watches Westfall from the watchtower roof. She serves the People's Militia, tracking the Defias Brotherhood and calling on travelers to bring back the outlaws' red silk bandanas.

Scout Riell watches the plains from the stone tower at Sentinel Hill, where banditry and harvest golems threaten Westfall. Stormwind's royal army is absent, and the crown refuses aid, leaving the People's Militia to defend the region. From the tower roof, Riell tracks the Defias Brotherhood's movements and gathers proof of their crimes. She calls on passing travelers to take red silk bandanas from the bandits.
